gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Pixel-era swagger, all gaping e's and stubby ascenders. Noto Sans Tagbanwa sits beneath it with open curves and tall lowercase, a modern sans that gives that wiry Visitor line something steady to lean on.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Visitor draws everything as thin, wire-like monoline. Noto Sans Tai Le follows with strokes that taper off before touching, and its capitals barely rise above the lowercase, so a long passage moves along smoothly and without fuss.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Nostalgic and a bit electric, Visitor lays down a marker-like line with big bowls under short ascenders. Noto Sans Tai Tham, a plain sans, crowds its lowercase upward and stays easy to see into.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet reads crisply, with a tall x-height, short ascenders and terminals pulled back from the curves. Visitor handles the attention-grabbing part with its ruler-straight lines, and the body font handles the steady, comfortable reading.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri brings a high-waisted lowercase where every small round letter is left generously unclosed, a plain sans through and through. Visitor's uniform o makes the contrast crisp.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Visitor is all solder-wire strokes with no hairlines anywhere. Noto Sans Tamil, a sans-serif that looks magnified, lets its terminals stop far from the stem, so the two sit together like retro signage next to a modern page.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tamil-su: Tube-bent lines and gaping e's, pure retro display. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, a plain sans, brings round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Nostalgic from the first glance, Visitor pulls a constant-width pen line with short ascenders over big bowls. Noto Sans Tangsa offers wide, inviting openings on its round letters, which suits steady reading far better than any display trick.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tc: Retro digital lettering with gaping e's, drawn with joins slim as a pipe cleaner. And Noto Sans TC, a sans with large open counters and curves that flare outward, keeps paragraphs inviting to read.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside. And Visitor, traced with one thickness throughout, is the one for punchy nostalgic display, while the body font does the quiet work of carrying text.
